project.name: AURORA
project.fullName: Adaptive Uncertainty-aware Radiative Observation and Ranging Architecture
project.tagline: Beyond fixed observations. Toward information-aware sensing.
project.question: Can a sensing system recognize when its observations are insufficient, identify missing information, and adapt its measurement configuration to recover that information?
project.mission: AURORA investigates whether existing sensing technologies can be improved through uncertainty-aware decision-making, adaptive spectral selection, complementary physical observables, and information-efficient measurement strategies.
project.disclaimer: AURORA is an ongoing scientific research project, not a commercially available or fully validated physical sensor.

researcher.name: Tamta Burduli
researcher.summary: Tamta Burduli is a researcher working across physics and remote sensing. Her work focuses on how much physical information about surfaces and atmospheres can be recovered from observations, and on when a set of observations is insufficient to answer a physical question.
researcher.statement: AURORA is an independent research initiative. It is not sponsored or endorsed by any university, laboratory, or government agency.
